newsitem.title: CROATIA: World Bank to help Croatia rebuild roads to Bosnia.
newsitem.headline: World Bank to help Croatia rebuild roads to Bosnia.

text.p: Croatia's government approved on Thursday a project to rebuild war-damaged road infrastructure linking it to neighbouring Bosnia-Herzegovina with the aid of the World Bank, state news agency HINA reported.
Total cost of the project is $107 million, of which the bank would shoulder $87 million. The Croatian government would provide the balance.
It would also cover mine-clearing operations in former war zones, HINA said.

Speaking on Croatian radio, Finance Minister Bozo Prka announced two other imminent foreign reconstruction loans but did not mention any figures or source of finance for them. -- Kolumbina Bencevic, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-41-4557075
